import os,json,System,Rhino
hub_root='C:\\Users\\08432.SINOLTD\\00.DEVE\\31.AEC\\RHINO_Deve\\EnvironmentalSimulationHub'
plugin_path=os.path.join(hub_root,'artifacts','runtime-v4','EnvironmentalHub.Plugin.rhp')
loaded=Rhino.PlugIns.PlugIn.LoadPlugIn(plugin_path)
Rhino.RhinoApp.RunScript('_EnvironmentalHub',False)
panel_id=System.Guid('c62382ce-7709-4fcd-9dfb-447d1d8a08c0')
panel=Rhino.UI.Panels.GetPanel(panel_id)
if panel is None:raise RuntimeError('Panel missing')
actual=panel.GetType().Assembly.Location
if 'runtime-v4' not in actual:raise RuntimeError('Wrong plugin loaded: '+actual)
doc=Rhino.RhinoDoc.ActiveDoc
doc.ModelUnitSystem=Rhino.UnitSystem.Meters
surface=Rhino.Geometry.PlaneSurface(Rhino.Geometry.Plane.WorldXY,Rhino.Geometry.Interval(0,4),Rhino.Geometry.Interval(0,4))
input_id=doc.Objects.AddBrep(surface.ToBrep())
receipt=json.load(open(os.path.join(hub_root,'samples','radiation_smoke','runtime_result.json'),encoding='utf-8'))
request={'GeometryIds':[str(input_id)],'WeatherFile':receipt['weather'],'OutputDirectory':os.path.join(hub_root,'samples','panel_validation_v4'),'GridMetres':1,'AcceptWarnings':True}
first=json.loads(panel.ExecuteJson(json.dumps(request)))
mean=first['Statistics']['Mean']
if abs(mean-1233.3471168086037)>1e-9:raise RuntimeError('Solver mismatch')
if panel.RenderedObjectCount!=1:raise RuntimeError('Preview missing')
old_text=panel.ResultText
invalid=dict(request);invalid['WeatherFile']='missing.epw'
failed=False
try:panel.ExecuteJson(json.dumps(invalid))
except Exception:failed=True
if not failed or panel.ResultText!=old_text or panel.RenderedObjectCount!=1:raise RuntimeError('Previous result lost after failure')
panel.ResetResult()
if panel.RenderedObjectCount!=0:raise RuntimeError('Reset failed')
second=json.loads(panel.ExecuteJson(json.dumps(request)))
report={'plugin_path':actual,'panel_visible':Rhino.UI.Panels.IsPanelVisible(panel_id),'mean':mean,'repeat_max_absolute_difference':max(abs(a-b) for a,b in zip(first['Values'],second['Values'])),'failure_preserves_previous_result':True,'reset_verified':True,'status':panel.StatusText,'result_text':panel.ResultText,'visual_qa':'PENDING','native_control_type':str(panel.ControlObject.GetType().FullName)}
json.dump(report,open(os.path.join(hub_root,'docs','evidence','panel_v4_runtime_validation.json'),'w',encoding='utf-8'),indent=2)
print(json.dumps(report))
